phase_name: Land the Anchor-Pointer Convention, Its Regression Lint, and a Pilot

objectives.description: Add the anchor-pointer convention standard under context/standards/
Write the inventory-driven regression lint (reads a permanent collapsed-block registry, not a hardcoded block list)
Write the lint's fixture suite with a deliberately-violating fixture plus conforming fixtures
Decide and record whether the lint gets a new gate row or rides an existing gate
Pilot the collapse on five files drawn from the inventory's highest sharing-factor eligible block, with a claim-retention ledger entry per file
Run the full gate set over the pilot and confirm the finding set matches the Phase 1 baseline; record the phase's NET-MD delta
